We invite you to submit forecasts to the `r cfg$challenge_long_name`!

This is an example challenge built from the
[challenge template](https://github.com/eco4cast/challenge-template): it
forecasts daily water temperature at two drinking-water reservoirs in Virginia.
The observations are from the Virginia Reservoirs LTREB project's
[VERA Forecasting Challenge](https://www.ltreb-reservoirs.org/vera4cast/).

The [instructions](instructions.qmd) explain how to take part, and
[what to forecast](targets.qmd) describes the targets.
